rows.text_en: Ministry of Health and Welfare ( Self-Sufficiency Policy Division ), 044-202-3074

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Welfare and Self-Reliance Support for Homeless Persons, etc. and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Welfare and Self-Reliance Support for Homeless Persons, etc. and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Definitions) In Article 2 , subparagraph 1 of the Act on Welfare and Self-Reliance Support for Homeless Persons, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), “person prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” means a person aged 18 or older.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Definitions) In Article 2 , subparagraph 1 of the Act on Welfare and Self-Reliance Support for Homeless Persons, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), “person prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” means a person aged 18 or older.

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Timing, Method, and Content of Fact-Finding Surveys, etc.) ① Pursuant to Article 9 of the Act , the Minister of Health and Welfare shall conduct a regular fact-finding survey every five years on the status of homeless people, etc. and the status of public and private support for them, and may supplement the regular fact-finding survey by conducting ad hoc fact-finding surveys if necessary.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Standards, etc. for Local Community Revitalization Projects) ① Local community revitalization projects eligible to receive necessary support, such as financial assistance, pursuant to Article 19-4, Paragraph 1 of the Special Act on the Improvement of Quality of Life of Farmers and Fishermen and the Promotion of Rural Development (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall meet all of the standards set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Apr. 21, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② The contents of the regular and ad hoc fact-finding surveys pursuant to Paragraph 1 are as follows:
rows.text_en: ② The contents of the regular and ad hoc fact-finding surveys pursuant to Paragraph 1 are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. Current status of homeless people, including number, residence, type of residence, gender, and age.
rows.text_en: 1. Current status of homeless people, including number, residence, type of residence, gender, and age.

rows.source_ko: 2. Current Status of Disabilities and Diseases Among the Homeless, etc.
rows.text_en: 2. Current Status of Disabilities and Diseases Among the Homeless, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. Types and contents of social welfare services received by homeless people, etc. from the State, local governments, and public institutions pursuant to Article 4 of the Act on the Operation of Public Institutions
rows.text_en: 3. Types and contents of social welfare services received by homeless people, etc. from the State, local governments, and public institutions pursuant to Article 4 of the Act on the Operation of Public Institutions

rows.source_ko: 4. Types and contents of social welfare services provided by the private sector to the homeless, etc.
rows.text_en: 4. Types and contents of social welfare services provided by the private sector to the homeless, etc.

rows.source_ko: ③ The Minister of Health and Welfare may commission the fact-finding survey under Paragraph 1 to an institution, corporation, or organization equipped with expertise, personnel, and equipment regarding homeless people, etc.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Health and Welfare may commission the fact-finding survey under Paragraph 1 to an institution, corporation, or organization equipped with expertise, personnel, and equipment regarding homeless people, etc.

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Reporting and Operation, etc. of Food Service Facilities for the Homeless) ①The standards for the installation and operation of food service facilities for the homeless pursuant to Article 11 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 1 .
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Reporting and Operation, etc. of Food Service Facilities for the Homeless) ① The standards for the installation and operation of food service facilities for the homeless pursuant to Article 11 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 1.

rows.source_ko: ② In accordance with Article 11, Paragraph 2 of the Act , if a person other than the State or a local government wishes to report the installation and operation of a meal service facility for the homeless, they must submit the Report on the Installation and Operation of Welfare Facilities for the Homeless ( Form No. 1 attached hereto ) (including a report in the form of an electronic document) to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Head (the District Head refers to the head of an autonomous district; hereinafter referred to as “Mayor, County Governor, or District Head”), attaching a copy of the Certificate of Report on the Installation and Operation of a Group Meal Service Facility pursuant to Article 94, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Rules of the Food Sanitation Act. <Amended Nov. 25, 2020>
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with Article 11, Paragraph 2 of the Act , if a person other than the State or a local government wishes to report the installation and operation of a meal service facility for the homeless, they must submit the Report on the Installation and Operation of Welfare Facilities for the Homeless ( Form No. 1 attached hereto ) (including a report in the form of an electronic document) to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Head (the District Head refers to the head of an autonomous district; hereinafter referred to as “Mayor, County Governor, or District Head”), attaching a copy of the Certificate of Report on the Installation and Operation of a Group Meal Service Facility pursuant to Article 94, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Rules of the Food Sanitation Act. <Amended Nov. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ③ If the report filed pursuant to Paragraph 2 complies with the standards for the installation and operation of meal facilities for the homeless pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head shall accept the report and issue a Certificate of Report for Homeless Welfare Facilities in the form of Annex 2. <Amended Nov. 25, 2020>
rows.text_en: ③ If the report filed pursuant to Paragraph 2 complies with the standards for the installation and operation of meal facilities for the homeless pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head shall accept the report and issue a Certificate of Report for Homeless Welfare Facilities in the form of Annex 2. <Amended Nov. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: Article 5 (Standards for Installation, Operation, and Designation of Homeless Medical Facilities, etc.) ①The standards for the installation and operation of homeless medical facilities pursuant to Article 12 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 1 .
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Standards for Installation, Operation, and Designation of Homeless Medical Facilities, etc.) ① The standards for the installation and operation of homeless medical facilities pursuant to Article 12 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 1.

rows.source_ko: ② The criteria for designating medical facilities for the homeless pursuant to Article 12 of the Act are as follows: <Amended Nov. 25, 2020>
rows.text_en: ② The criteria for designating medical facilities for the homeless pursuant to Article 12 of the Act are as follows: <Amended Nov. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. It must be a primary medical benefit institution pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Medical Benefits Act or a secondary medical benefit institution pursuant to Subparagraph 2 of the same Paragraph.
rows.text_en: 1. It must be a primary medical benefit institution pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Medical Benefits Act or a secondary medical benefit institution pursuant to Subparagraph 2 of the same Paragraph.

rows.source_ko: 2. Equip facilities and equipment capable of providing sufficient medical services, taking into account the actual situation of the homeless population in the relevant area and their health and disease status.
rows.text_en: 2. Equip facilities and equipment capable of providing sufficient medical services, taking into account the actual situation of the homeless population in the relevant area and their health and disease status.

rows.source_ko: ③ If a Mayor, County Governor, or District Head intends to designate a medical facility for the homeless pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Act , they must consult with the relevant national or public hospital, public health center, or private medical institution in advance. <Amended Nov. 25, 2020>
rows.text_en: ③ If a Mayor, County Governor, or District Head intends to designate a medical facility for the homeless pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Act , they must consult with the relevant national or public hospital, public health center, or private medical institution in advance. <Amended Nov. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제12조제4항에 따라 국가와 지방자치단체 외의 자가 노숙인진료시설을 설치ㆍ운영하려면 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 노숙인진료시설 지정을 신청해야 한다. <개정 2020. 11. 25.>
rows.text_en: ④ Pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 4 of the Act , if a person other than the State or a local government intends to establish and operate a medical facility for the homeless, they must apply to the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head for designation as a medical facility for the homeless. <Amended Nov. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제4항에 따라 국가와 지방자치단체 외의 자가 노숙인진료시설 지정을 신청하려면 별지 제3호서식의 노숙인진료시설 지정신청서에 「의료법 시행규칙」 제25조제3항 또는 제27조제3항에 따른 의료기관 개설신고증명서 또는 의료기관 개설허가증의 사본을 첨부하여 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2020. 11. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ In order for a person other than the State or a local government to apply for the designation of a medical facility for the homeless pursuant to Paragraph 4, they shall submit an application for designation of a medical facility for the homeless in the form of Annex 3 to the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head, attaching a copy of the certificate of notification of establishment of a medical institution or the license to establish a medical institution pursuant to Article 25 , Paragraph 3 or Article 27 , Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Rules of the Medical Service Act. <Amended Nov. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제5항에 따른 신청이 제1항에 따른 노숙인진료시설 설치ㆍ운영 기준 및 제2항에 따른 지정기준에 적합한 경우에는 해당 의료기관을 노숙인진료시설로 지정할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ If an application under paragraph 5 meets the standards for the installation and operation of homeless medical facilities under paragraph 1 and the designation standards under paragraph 2, the mayor, county governor, or district head may designate the relevant medical institution as a homeless medical facility.

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제3항 및 제6항에 따라 노숙인진료시설을 지정한 경우에는 별지 제4호서식의 노숙인진료시설 지정서를 발급해야 한다. <개정 2020. 11. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ When a Mayor, County Governor, or District Head designates a medical facility for the homeless pursuant to Paragraphs 3 and 6, they shall issue a Certificate of Designation for a Medical Facility for the Homeless in the form of Annex 4. <Amended Nov. 25, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 제1항부터 제7항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 노숙인진료시설의 설치ㆍ운영 및 지정 절차 등 의료지원에 필요한 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 7, matters necessary for medical support, such as the procedures for the establishment, operation, and designation of medical facilities for the homeless, shall be determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare .

rows.source_ko: 제6조(자활지원사업 신고) ① 법 제13조제3항에 따라 국가와 지방자치단체 외의 자가 노숙인 등에 대한 자활지원사업 실시 신고를 하려면 별지 제5호서식의 노숙인자활지원사업 실시 신고서(전자문서로 된 신고서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Reporting of Self-Sufficiency Support Project) ① In accordance with Article 13, Paragraph 3 of the Act, if a person other than the State or a local government wishes to report the implementation of a self-sufficiency support project for homeless people, etc., they must submit the following documents (including electronic documents) attached to the report on the implementation of the self-sufficiency support project for homeless people in the form of Annex No. 5 to the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head.

rows.source_ko: 1. 법인의 정관(법인인 경우만 해당한다) 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of the Articles of Incorporation of a corporation (applicable only to corporations).

rows.source_ko: 2. 사업계획서 및 예산서 각 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy each of the business plan and budget

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 신고서를 받은 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우만 해당한다)를 확인하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The mayor, county governor, or district head who receives the report pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the certificate of corporate registration (only applicable to corporations) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act .

rows.source_ko: ③ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제1항에 따라 신고를 받은 경우에는 별지 제6호서식의 노숙인자활지원사업 실시 신고증을 발급하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When a mayor, county governor, or district head receives a report pursuant to Paragraph 1, they shall issue a report on the implementation of the homeless self-reliance support project in the form of Annex 6 .

rows.source_ko: 제7조(노숙인시설의 설치ㆍ운영 기준 등) 법 제15조에 따른 노숙인시설의 설치ㆍ운영 기준은 별표 1과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Standards for Installation and Operation of Homeless Facilities, etc.) The standards for the installation and operation of homeless facilities pursuant to Article 15 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 1 .

rows.source_ko: 제8조(노숙인복지시설의 설치ㆍ운영 신고) ① 법 제15조제2항에 따라 국가와 지방자치단체 외의 자가 노숙인복지시설(제4조에 따른 노숙인급식시설 및 제5조에 따른 노숙인진료시설은 제외한다) 설치ㆍ운영 신고를 하려면 별지 제1호서식의 노숙인복지시설 설치ㆍ운영 신고서(전자문서로 된 신고서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Reporting of Installation and Operation of Welfare Facilities for the Homeless) ① In accordance with Article 15, Paragraph 2 of the Act, if a person other than the State and local governments wishes to report the installation and operation of a welfare facility for the homeless (excluding food service facilities for the homeless pursuant to Article 4 and medical treatment facilities for the homeless pursuant to Article 5), they shall submit to the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head a report on the installation and operation of a welfare facility for the homeless in the form of Annex No. 1 (including a report in the form of an electronic document) with the following documents (including electronic documents) attached.

rows.source_ko: 1. 법인의 정관(법인인 경우만 해당한다) 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of the Articles of Incorporation of a corporation (applicable only to corporations).

rows.source_ko: 2. 시설 운영에 필요한 재산목록(소유를 증명할 수 있는 서류를 첨부하되, 국유ㆍ공유의 토지 또는 건물에 시설을 설치ㆍ운영하려는 경우에는 그 사용권을 증명할 수 있는 서류로 갈음할 수 있다) 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of the inventory of assets necessary for the operation of the facility (documents proving ownership must be attached; however, in cases where the facility is to be installed or operated on state-owned or public land or buildings, documents proving the right of use may be substituted).

rows.source_ko: 3. 사업계획서 및 예산서 각 1부
rows.text_en: 3. One copy each of the business plan and budget

rows.source_ko: 4. 시설의 평면도(시설의 층별 및 구조별 면적을 표시하여야 한다)와 건물의 배치도 각 1부
rows.text_en: 4. One copy each of the floor plan of the facility (which must indicate the area by floor and structure) and the building layout plan.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 신고서를 받은 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우만 해당한다), 건물 등기사항증명서 및 토지 등기사항증명서를 확인하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The mayor, county governor, or district head who receives the report pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the certificate of corporate registration (only applicable to corporations), the certificate of building registration, and the certificate of land registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36 Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act.

rows.source_ko: ③ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제1항에 따른 신고가 제7조에 따른 노숙인복지시설 설치ㆍ운영 기준에 적합한 경우에는 신고를 수리하고, 별지 제2호서식의 노숙인복지시설 신고증을 발급하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ If the report under Paragraph 1 is in compliance with the standards for the installation and operation of homeless welfare facilities under Article 7 , the mayor, county governor, or district head shall accept the report and issue a homeless welfare facility report certificate in the form of Annex 2 .

rows.source_ko: 제9조(노숙인복지시설의 사업내용) 법 제16조제1항에 따른 노숙인복지시설의 구체적인 사업내용은 별표 2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Business Contents of Homeless Welfare Facilities) The specific business contents of homeless welfare facilities pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 2 .
[Wholly revised June 12, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(노숙인진료시설의 이용절차) ① 법 제16조제1항제6호에 따른 노숙인진료시설(이하 “노숙인진료시설”이라 한다)을 이용하려는 노숙인 등은 제11조제1항ㆍ제3항 및 제14조제2항에 따라 법 제16조제1항제1호에 따른 노숙인일시보호시설(이하 “노숙인일시보호시설”이라 한다) 또는 법 제16조제1항제2호에 따른 노숙인자활시설(이하 “노숙인자활시설”이라 한다)에 입소하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Procedure for Use of Homeless Medical Facilities) ① Homeless persons, etc. who wish to use a homeless medical facility pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 6 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “homeless medical facility”) must enter a homeless temporary shelter facility pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “homeless temporary shelter facility”) or a homeless self-reliance facility pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “homeless self-reliance facility”) in accordance with Article 11, Paragraphs 1 and 3 and Article 14, Paragraph 2.

rows.source_ko: ② 노숙인일시보호시설 또는 노숙인자활시설의 장은 제1항에 따라 입소한 노숙인 등이 노숙인진료시설 이용을 요청하는 경우 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제11조제1항 각 호의 사항 및 노숙인진료시설 이용이 필요한 사유를 적은 서류를 제출하고 노숙인진료시설 이용을 신청하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When a homeless person admitted pursuant to Paragraph 1 requests to use a homeless medical facility, the head of a temporary shelter for the homeless or a self-reliance facility for the homeless shall submit a document stating the matters specified in each subparagraph of Article 11 Paragraph 1 and the reason why the use of the homeless medical facility is necessary to the mayor, county governor, or district head, and apply for the use of the homeless medical facility.

rows.source_ko: ③ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제2항에 따라 노숙인진료시설 이용 신청을 받으면 해당 노숙인 등의 노숙인진료시설 이용 여부를 결정하고 그 결과를 노숙인일시보호시설 또는 노숙인자활시설의 장을 통하여 해당 노숙인 등에게 통보하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When a mayor, county governor, or district head receives an application for the use of a homeless medical facility pursuant to paragraph 2, they shall decide whether to allow the homeless person, etc. to use the homeless medical facility and notify the homeless person, etc. of the result through the head of the homeless temporary shelter or homeless self-reliance facility.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지에서 정한 사항 외에 노숙인진료시설의 이용 방법 및 절차에 관하여 필요한 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters set forth in paragraphs 1 through 3, necessary matters concerning the methods and procedures for using medical facilities for the homeless shall be determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare .

rows.source_ko: 제11조(노숙인 등의 입소의 기준ㆍ방법ㆍ절차 등) ① 법 제17조제1항에 따라 노숙인 등이 법 제16조제1항제2호부터 제4호까지의 규정에 따른 노숙인자활시설, 노숙인재활시설 및 노숙인요양시설(이하 “입소시설”이라 한다)의 장에게 입소를 신청한 경우 입소시설의 장은 해당 노숙인 등의 연고자, 건강 상태, 노숙생활 실태 및 자립계획 등을 조사ㆍ상담한 후 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 다음 각 호의 사항을 적은 서류를 제출하고 노숙인 등의 입소심사를 요청하여야 한다. 다만, 노숙인자활시설에 입소를 신청한 노숙인 등에 대해서는 조사ㆍ상담을 거쳐 입소시킨 후 별지 제7호서식의 노숙인 등 입소보고서에 따라 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 보고하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Standards, Methods, Procedures, etc. for Admission of Homeless Persons, etc.) ① In cases where a homeless person, etc. applies for admission to the head of a self-reliance facility for the homeless, a rehabilitation facility for the homeless, or a nursing facility for the homeless (hereinafter referred to as “admission facility”) pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act, the head of the admission facility shall investigate and counsel the relevant relatives, health status, actual living conditions as a homeless person, and self-reliance plan, and then submit documents containing the matters in each of the following subparagraphs to the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head and request an admission screening of the homeless person, etc. However, for a homeless person, etc. who has applied for admission to a self-reliance facility for the homeless, the head of the admission facility shall admit them after investigation and counseling, and then report to the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head in accordance with the Admission Report for Homeless Persons, etc. in Annex 7.

rows.source_ko: 1. 노숙인 등의 인적사항: 성명, 성별, 주민등록번호, 등록기준지 및 주소
rows.text_en: 1. Personal details of homeless persons, etc.: Name, gender, resident registration number, registered domicile, and address

rows.source_ko: 2. 조사ㆍ상담 결과: 노숙인 등의 상태, 연고자 유무 및 상담 의견
rows.text_en: 2. Results of Investigation and Counseling: Condition of homeless individuals, presence of relatives, and counseling opinions

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제17조제2항에 따라 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장 또는 경찰관서(지구대ㆍ파출소 및 출장소를 포함한다. 이하 같다)의 장이 입소시설에 노숙인 등의 입소를 의뢰하려는 경우에는 별지 제8호서식의 입소시설 보호요청서(경찰관서의 장의 경우에는 「경찰관 직무집행법 시행령」 별지 제2호서식의 피구호자 인계서로 갈음할 수 있다. 이하 이 항에서 같다)를 법 제19조에 따른 노숙인종합지원센터(이하 “노숙인종합지원센터”라 한다)의 장에게 송부하고 그 노숙인 등을 인계한다. 다만, 시ㆍ군ㆍ구(자치구를 말한다) 또는 경찰관서가 속해 있는 특별시ㆍ광역시ㆍ도ㆍ특별자치도에 노숙인종합지원센터가 없는 경우에는 입소시설의 장에게 별지 제8호서식의 입소시설 보호요청서를 송부하고 그 노숙인 등을 인계할 수 있으며, 노숙인 등을 인계받은 입소시설의 장은 제1항에 따라 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 노숙인 등의 입소심사를 요청하거나 입소보고를 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with Article 17, Paragraph 2 of the Act , when a mayor, county governor, district head, or the head of a police station (including police substations, police boxes, and branch offices; hereinafter the same applies) intends to request the admission of homeless persons, etc. to an admission facility, they shall send the Request for Protection to Admission Facility Form No. 8 (in the case of the head of a police station, it may be substituted with the Request for Transfer of Person in Relief Form No. 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Execution of Duties by Police Officers ; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph) to the head of the Homeless Comprehensive Support Center pursuant to Article 19 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Homeless Comprehensive Support Center”) and transfer the homeless persons, etc. However, in cases where there is no comprehensive support center for the homeless in the special city, metropolitan city, province, or special autonomous province to which the city, county, or district (referring to an autonomous district) or police station belongs, the request for protection in the admission facility in the form of Annex 8 may be sent to the head of the admission facility and the homeless person, etc. may be transferred thereto, and the head of the admission facility who receives the homeless person, etc. shall request an admission screening of the homeless person, etc. or report the admission to the mayor, county governor, or district head in accordance with Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: ③ 노숙인종합지원센터의 장은 제2항 본문에 따라 노숙인 등을 인계받은 경우 또는 입소시설에 입소를 희망하는 노숙인 등이 있는 경우에는 해당 노숙인 등의 연고자, 건강 상태, 노숙생활 실태 및 자립계획 등을 조사ㆍ상담한 후 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제1항 각 호의 사항을 적은 서류를 제출하고 노숙인 등의 입소심사를 요청하여야 한다. 다만, 조사ㆍ상담 결과 노숙인자활시설로 입소할 필요가 있는 경우에는 별지 제9호서식의 노숙인 등 입소의뢰서에 따라 노숙인자활시설의 장에게 노숙인 등의 입소를 의뢰하고 해당 노숙인 등을 인계하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the head of the Homeless Support Center receives a homeless person, etc. in accordance with the main text of Paragraph 2, or when there is a homeless person, etc. who wishes to be admitted to an admission facility, he/she shall investigate and counsel the relatives, health status, actual living conditions, and self-reliance plans of the homeless person, etc., and then submit documents containing the matters in each subparagraph of Paragraph 1 to the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head and request an admission screening for the homeless person, etc. However, if the investigation and counseling results indicate that admission to a homeless self-reliance facility is necessary, he/she shall request admission of the homeless person, etc. to the head of the homeless self-reliance facility in accordance with the Admission Request Form for Homeless Persons, etc. ( Form No. 9) and transfer the homeless person, etc.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제3항 단서에 따라 노숙인 등의 입소를 의뢰받은 노숙인자활시설의 장은 해당 노숙인 등을 인계받은 후 별지 제7호서식의 노숙인 등 입소보고서에 따라 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 보고하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The head of a self-reliance facility for the homeless who has been asked to admit the homeless person, etc. pursuant to the proviso of Paragraph 3 shall report to the mayor, county governor, or district head in accordance with the admission report for the homeless person, etc. in Form No. 7 of the attached document after receiving the said homeless person, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 입소시설의 장 또는 노숙인종합지원센터의 장은 제1항 또는 제2항에 따라 노숙인 등으로부터 입소 신청을 받거나 노숙인 등을 인계받은 경우에는 별지 제10호서식의 입소요청대장에 인적사항 등을 적어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ When the head of an admission facility or the head of a comprehensive support center for the homeless receives an application for admission from a homeless person, etc. or takes over a homeless person, etc. in accordance with Paragraph 1 or 2, they must record personal information, etc. in the admission request ledger in Form No. 10 attached hereto .

rows.source_ko: 제12조(노숙인 등의 입소심사 등) ① 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제11조제1항 또는 제3항에 따라 노숙인 등의 입소심사를 요청받은 경우에는 지체 없이 법 제17조제3항에 따른 입소ㆍ퇴소심사위원회(이하 “심사위원회”라 한다)를 개최하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Admission Examination, etc. for Homeless Persons) ① When a mayor, county governor, or district head receives a request for an admission examination for homeless persons, etc. pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 or 3, they shall convene the Admission and Discharge Examination Committee (hereinafter referred to as the “Examination Committee”) pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 3 of the Act without delay.

rows.source_ko: ② 심사위원회는 제14조제1항에 따라 노숙인 등을 노숙인일시보호시설 또는 입소시설에서 보호하기 시작한 날부터 30일 이내에 해당 노숙인 등의 연고자, 건강 상태, 노숙생활 실태 및 자립계획 등을 검토하여 입소 여부를 결정하고, 그 결과를 별지 제11호서식의 입소ㆍ퇴소 심사서에 따라 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 통보하여야 한다. 이 경우 해당 노숙인 등이 입소할 수 있는 입소시설의 종류 및 위치, 해당 시설에서 제공되는 서비스 등에 관한 정보를 함께 제공할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The Review Committee shall, in accordance with Article 14, Paragraph 1, review the relatives, health status, actual living conditions, and self-reliance plans of the homeless person, etc., within 30 days from the date of commencement of protection at a temporary shelter or admission facility for the homeless, etc., and decide whether to admit them, and notify the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head of the results in accordance with the Admission/Discharge Review Form (Form No. 11) . In this case, information regarding the type and location of the admission facility where the homeless person, etc. may be admitted, and the services provided at the facility, etc., may be provided together.

rows.source_ko: ③ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제2항에 따른 통보를 받은 경우에는 제11조제1항 또는 제3항에 따라 노숙인 등의 입소심사를 요청한 입소시설의 장 또는 노숙인종합지원센터의 장에게 별지 제9호서식의 노숙인 등 입소의뢰서를 송부하여야 한다. 이 경우 노숙인종합지원센터의 장은 송부받은 노숙인 등 입소의뢰서를 입소시설의 장에게 송부하고 노숙인일시보호시설의 장으로 하여금 해당 노숙인 등을 인계하게 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When a mayor, county governor, or district head receives a notification pursuant to Paragraph 2, they shall send a request for admission of a homeless person, etc. in the form of Annex 9 to the head of the admission facility or the head of the Homeless Support Center who requested the admission screening of the homeless person, etc. pursuant to Article 11 , Paragraph 1 or 3. In this case, the head of the Homeless Support Center shall forward the received request for admission of the homeless person, etc. to the head of the admission facility and have the head of the temporary shelter for the homeless transfer the relevant homeless person, etc.

rows.source_ko: ④ 이 규칙에서 정한 사항 외에 노숙인 등의 입소 방법ㆍ절차 등에 관한 세부 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters set forth in this rule, detailed matters concerning the methods and procedures for admission of homeless people, etc. shall be determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare .

rows.source_ko: 제13조(입소 보고 등) ① 제12조제3항에 따라 노숙인 등의 입소의뢰서를 받은 입소시설의 장은 노숙인 등을 입소시킨 후 별지 제7호서식의 노숙인 등 입소보고서에 따라 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 보고하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Report on Admission, etc.) ① The head of an admission facility who has received a request for admission of homeless persons, etc. pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 3 shall report to the mayor, county governor, or district head after admitting the homeless persons, etc., in accordance with the report on admission of homeless persons, etc. in Form No. 7 attached hereto.

rows.source_ko: ② 입소시설의 장은 입소한 노숙인 등에 대하여 별지 제12호서식의 노숙인 등 신상기록카드 및 별지 제13호서식의 입소자 등 명부를 작성ㆍ관리하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of the admission facility shall prepare and manage the personal record card of homeless persons, etc. in Form No. 12 and the register of admission persons, etc. in Form No. 13 for homeless persons, etc. admitted to the facility .

rows.source_ko: 제14조(노숙인 등의 일시보호) ① 입소시설의 장 또는 노숙인종합지원센터의 장은 제11조제1항 또는 제3항에 따라 노숙인 등의 입소심사를 요청한 경우에는 제12조제3항에 따라 입소의뢰서를 송부받을 때까지 해당 노숙인 등을 각각 해당 입소시설에서 보호하거나 노숙인일시보호시설에 보호를 의뢰하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Temporary Protection of Homeless Persons, etc.) ① When the head of an admission facility or the head of a comprehensive support center for the homeless requests an admission screening of homeless persons, etc. pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 or 3, they shall protect the homeless persons, etc. at the respective admission facility or refer them for protection to a temporary protection facility for the homeless until they receive an admission request form pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 3.

rows.source_ko: ② 노숙인일시보호시설 또는 입소시설의 장은 노숙인 등이 일시적으로 보호받기를 희망하는 경우 또는 「노숙인 등의 복지 및 자립지원에 관한 법률 시행령」 제6조제3항제2호다목에 따른 보호 의뢰를 받은 경우에는 20일을 초과하지 아니하는 범위에서 노숙인 등을 해당 노숙인일시보호시설 또는 입소시설에서 보호할 수 있다. 다만, 노숙인일시보호시설에서 보호하는 경우로서 노숙인 등의 건강 상태 등을 고려할 때 계속 보호가 필요한 경우에는 10일간 보호기간을 연장할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of a temporary shelter for the homeless or an admission facility may provide protection to the homeless, etc. at the relevant temporary shelter or admission facility for a period not exceeding 20 days if the homeless, etc. wishes to be temporarily protected or if a request for protection is received pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 2, Item C of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Welfare and Self-Reliance Support for the Homeless, etc. However, in cases where protection is provided at a temporary shelter for the homeless and continued protection is necessary considering the health condition of the homeless, etc., the protection period may be extended by 10 days.

rows.source_ko: ③ 노숙인일시보호시설의 장은 보호하고 있는 노숙인 등에 대하여 별지 제13호서식의 입소자 등 명부를 작성ㆍ관리하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The head of a temporary shelter for the homeless shall prepare and manage a register of residents, etc. in the form of Annex 13 for the homeless people under his/her protection .

rows.source_ko: 제15조(노숙인 등의 퇴소의 기준ㆍ방법ㆍ절차) ① 입소시설의 장은 해당 시설에 입소한 노숙인 등에 대하여 매월 1회 이상 상담하여 사회복귀가 가능한 사람이 있는지 파악하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Criteria, Methods, and Procedures for Discharge of Homeless Persons, etc.) ① The head of an admission facility shall counsel homeless persons, etc. admitted to the facility at least once a month to identify whether there are any who are capable of returning to society.

rows.source_ko: ② 입소시설의 장은 사회복귀가 가능하다고 인정되는 사람이 있는 경우에는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제11조제1항 각 호의 사항을 적은 서류를 제출하고 노숙인 등의 퇴소심사를 요청하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If there is a person recognized as capable of social reintegration, the head of the admission facility shall submit a document containing the matters specified in each subparagraph of Article 11, Paragraph 1 to the mayor, county governor, or district head and request a review of the discharge of the homeless person, etc.

rows.source_ko: ③ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제2항에 따라 노숙인 등의 퇴소심사를 요청받은 경우에는 심사위원회를 개최하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When a mayor, county governor, or district head receives a request for an examination of the discharge of homeless persons, etc. pursuant to Paragraph 2, they shall convene an examination committee.

rows.source_ko: ④ 심사위원회는 노숙인 등의 사회복귀 가능성 등을 검토하여 퇴소 여부를 결정하고 그 결과를 별지 제11호서식의 입소ㆍ퇴소 심사서에 따라 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 통보하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The review committee shall review the possibility of social reintegration of homeless people, etc., and decide whether to discharge them, and notify the results to the mayor, county governor, or district head in accordance with the admission/discharge review form in Annex 11 .

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제4항에 따라 노숙인 등의 퇴소 여부 결정을 통보받은 경우에는 지체 없이 입소시설의 장에게 그 결과를 통보하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ When a mayor, county governor, or district head receives notification of a decision regarding the discharge of homeless people, etc. pursuant to Paragraph 4, they shall notify the head of the admission facility of the result without delay.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 입소시설의 장은 제5항에 따라 퇴소결정을 통보받은 경우 또는 입소한 노숙인 등 및 그 보호자가 법 제17조제1항에 따라 퇴소를 요청한 경우에는 즉시 해당 노숙인 등을 퇴소시켜야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The head of the admission facility shall immediately discharge the homeless person, etc., who has been admitted, if notified of a decision to discharge pursuant to Paragraph 5, or if the homeless person, etc. admitted and their guardian request discharge pursuant to Article 17 Paragraph 1 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 제1항부터 제6항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 노숙인 등의 퇴소의 방법ㆍ절차 등에 관한 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 6, matters concerning the methods and procedures for the discharge of homeless people, etc. shall be determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare .

rows.source_ko: 제16조(퇴소 보고 등) ① 입소시설의 장은 입소한 노숙인 등이 사망한 경우 또는 제15조에 따라 퇴소한 경우에는 그 사실을 별지 제14호서식의 퇴소ㆍ사망 보고서에 따라 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 보고하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Report on Discharge, etc.) ① The head of an admission facility shall report the fact to the mayor, county governor, or district head in accordance with the Discharge/Death Report Form No. 14 attached hereto, in the event that a homeless person admitted to the facility dies or is discharged pursuant to Article 15 .

rows.source_ko: ② 노숙인일시보호시설 또는 입소시설의 장은 매월 사망한 노숙인 등에 관한 사항을 별지 제15호서식의 사망자 조치사항 보고서에 따라 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 보고하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of a temporary shelter for the homeless or an admission facility shall report matters concerning deceased homeless persons, etc., to the mayor, county governor, or district head every month in accordance with the report on measures taken for deceased persons in Form No. 15 .

rows.source_ko: 제17조(전원조치 등) ① 노숙인일시보호시설 또는 입소시설의 장은 보호하고 있는 노숙인 등에 대하여 수시로 면담ㆍ관찰ㆍ지도를 하고 특이사항을 기록ㆍ관리하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Measures for Transfer, etc.) ① The head of a temporary shelter for the homeless or an admission facility shall interview, observe, and guide the homeless persons under his/her protection from time to time, and record and manage any unusual circumstances.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 면담ㆍ관찰ㆍ지도의 결과 해당 시설에서 보호하는 것이 적합하지 아니하다고 판단되는 경우에는 해당 노숙인 등을 「사회복지사업법」 제2조제4호에 따른 다른 사회복지시설 또는 다른 법률에 따른 보호시설로 전원(轉院)하는 등 필요한 조치를 하여야 한다. 이 경우 노숙인일시보호시설 또는 입소시설의 장은 해당 지역의 노숙인종합지원센터의 장과 협의할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② If, as a result of the interview, observation, and guidance pursuant to Paragraph 1, it is determined that protection at the relevant facility is not appropriate, necessary measures shall be taken, such as transferring the homeless person concerned to another social welfare facility pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 4 of the Social Welfare Services Act or to a protection facility under other laws. In this case, the head of the temporary shelter or residential facility for the homeless may consult with the head of the comprehensive support center for the homeless in the relevant area.

rows.source_ko: 제18조(심사위원회의 구성ㆍ운영) ① 심사위원회는 위원장을 포함하여 5명 이상 9명 이하의 위원으로 구성한다.
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Composition and Operation of the Review Committee) ① The Review Committee shall be composed of five to nine members, including the Chairperson.

rows.source_ko: ② 위원은 노숙인시설의 장, 사회복지 전문가, 종교인, 의사, 교육자, 관계 공무원, 그 밖에 시설 운영에 관하여 전문적인 지식과 경험이 풍부한 사람 중에서 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 위촉하거나 임명하고, 위원장은 위원 중에서 호선(互選)한다.
rows.text_en: ② Members shall be commissioned or appointed by the mayor, county governor, or district head from among the heads of homeless shelters, social welfare experts, religious figures, doctors, educators, relevant public officials, and other persons with extensive professional knowledge and experience in facility operation, and the chairperson shall be elected by mutual consent from among the members.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에서 규정한 사항 외에 심사위원회의 구성 및 운영에 필요한 사항은 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, matters necessary for the composition and operation of the Review Committee shall be determined by the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head.

rows.source_ko: 제18조의2(사망한 입소자의 장례비용 충당절차) ① 노숙인복지시설의 장이 법 제17조제4항 후단에 따라 사망자가 유류한 금전이나 유가증권 또는 유류물품을 처분한 대금(이하 이 조에서 “유류금”이라 한다)을 그 장례에 필요한 비용에 충당하려면 장례비용 및 장례절차 등에 관한 사항을 미리 보건복지부장관, 시ㆍ도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장과 협의해야 한다. 이 경우 장례절차에 대하여 사망자의 유언이 있는 때에는 그에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 18-2 (Procedure for Covering Funeral Expenses of Deceased Residents) ① If the head of a homeless welfare facility intends to cover the expenses necessary for the funeral with money, securities, or proceeds from the disposal of inherited goods left by the deceased (hereinafter referred to as “inherited funds” in this Article) pursuant to the latter part of Article 17, Paragraph 4 of the Act, he/she shall consult in advance with the Minister of Health and Welfare, the Governor of a City or Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head regarding matters concerning funeral expenses and funeral procedures, etc. In this case, if there is a will of the deceased regarding the funeral procedures, it shall be followed.

rows.source_ko: ② 노숙인복지시설의 장이 제1항에 따라 유류금을 그 장례에 필요한 비용에 충당한 경우에는 그 결과를 보건복지부장관, 시ㆍ도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 통지해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If the head of a homeless welfare facility covers the expenses necessary for the funeral in accordance with Paragraph 1, he/she must notify the Minister of Health and Welfare, the governor of a city or province, or the mayor, county head, or district head of the result.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에서 규정한 사항 외에 장례비용 충당의 세부절차에 관하여 필요한 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, necessary matters regarding the detailed procedures for covering funeral expenses shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Health and Welfare .
[This Article Newly Inserted June 30, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제18조의3(상속인 없는 재산의 처리절차) ① 노숙인복지시설을 설치ㆍ운영하는 자는 사망한 사람의 잔여재산이 법 제17조의2제1항 단서에 해당하는 경우에는 그 시설에 입소 중인 사람이 사망한 후 30일 이내에 관할 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 잔여재산 목록을 작성하여 보고해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 18-3 (Procedure for Disposition of Property Without Heirs) ① A person who establishes and operates a welfare facility for the homeless shall, in cases where the remaining property of a deceased person falls under the proviso to Article 17-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act, prepare and report a list of remaining property to the competent mayor, county governor, or district head within 30 days after the death of a person residing in the facility.

rows.source_ko: ② 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제17조의2제2항에 따라 공고하는 경우에는 시ㆍ군ㆍ구의 인터넷 홈페이지 또는 「신문 등의 진흥에 관한 법률」 제9조제1항에 따라 그 보급지역을 전국으로 등록한 일반일간신문에 게재하는 방법으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When a mayor, county governor, or district head makes a public announcement pursuant to Article 17-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act , they shall do so by posting on the internet homepage of the city, county, or district or in a general daily newspaper registered for distribution nationwide pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Promotion of Newspapers, etc.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에서 규정한 사항 외에 상속인 없는 재산의 처리에 관하여 필요한 세부사항은 보건복지부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, the Minister of Health and Welfare shall determine and announce the necessary detailed matters regarding the disposition of property without heirs .
[This Article Newly Inserted June 30, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제19조(자활 및 재활프로그램 운영 등) ① 법 제18조제1항에 따라 입소시설의 장은 해당 시설의 특성 및 보호하고 있는 노숙인 등의 특성에 맞는 자활 및 재활프로그램을 제공하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Operation of Self-Sufficiency and Rehabilitation Programs, etc.) ① Pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the head of an admission facility shall provide self-sufficiency and rehabilitation programs tailored to the characteristics of the facility and the characteristics of the homeless persons, etc. being protected.

rows.source_ko: ② 입소시설의 장은 해당 입소시설 외의 기관이 실시하는 재활 및 자활 관련 프로그램에 노숙인 등이 적극적으로 참여할 수 있도록 필요한 조치를 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of the residential facility shall take necessary measures to ensure that homeless people, etc., can actively participate in rehabilitation and self-sufficiency programs conducted by institutions other than the residential facility.

rows.source_ko: 제20조(건강관리 등) ① 법 제18조제1항에 따라 노숙인일시보호시설 또는 입소시설의 장은 노숙인 등의 건강관리를 위하여 다음 각 호의 조치를 하여야 한다. 다만, 제4호의 조치는 입소인원이 상시 100명 미만인 노숙인자활시설에 대해서는 적용하지 아니한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Health Management, etc.) ① Pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the head of a temporary shelter for the homeless or an admission facility shall take the following measures for the health management of the homeless, etc. However, the measure under Subparagraph 4 shall not apply to a self-reliance facility for the homeless where the number of residents is less than 100 at all times.

rows.source_ko: 1. 노숙인 등의 입소 후 10일 이내에 건강진단을 실시하고 매년 1회 이상 건강진단을 실시할 것. 다만, 노숙인일시보호시설의 경우에는 노숙인 등의 보호가 시작된 날부터 3일 이내에 건강진단을 실시하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: 1. Conduct a health examination for homeless persons, etc. within 10 days of admission and conduct a health examination at least once a year. However, in the case of temporary shelters for the homeless, a health examination must be conducted within 3 days from the date the protection of homeless persons, etc. begins.

rows.source_ko: 2. 입소시설 및 노숙인일시보호시설에서 진료하기에 적합하지 않은 환자에 대해서는 의료기관 등에서 치료받게 하는 등 필요한 조치를 할 것
rows.text_en: 2. For patients who are not suitable for treatment at residential facilities or temporary shelters for the homeless, take necessary measures, such as having them receive treatment at medical institutions.

rows.source_ko: 3. 노숙인 등의 건강 상태에 따라 적절한 운동과 휴식을 하게 하고, 위생관리에 유의할 것
rows.text_en: 3. Ensure homeless individuals and others engage in appropriate exercise and rest according to their health condition, and pay attention to hygiene management.

rows.source_ko: 4. 노숙인 등에 대하여 별지 제16호서식의 개인별 건강기록부와 별지 제17호서식의 의무일지를 작성하여 갖추어 둘 것
rows.text_en: 4. For homeless persons, etc., prepare and keep the individual health record in Form No. 16 and the medical log in Form No. 17.

rows.source_ko: 제21조(상담) 노숙인시설(노숙인급식시설 및 노숙인진료시설은 제외한다)의 장은 보호하고 있는 노숙인 등에 대하여 재활ㆍ자활ㆍ주거ㆍ고용 상담 또는 그 밖의 상담을 하는 경우 상담 내용을 별지 제18호서식의 상담일지에 따라 작성하고 관리하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Counseling) The head of a homeless shelter (excluding homeless food service facilities and homeless medical facilities) shall, when providing counseling on rehabilitation, self-sufficiency, housing, employment, or other matters to homeless people under protection, record and manage the counseling details in accordance with the counseling log in Form No. 18 attached hereto.

rows.source_ko: 제22조(노숙인종합지원센터의 업무) ① 법 제19조제5호에서 “보건복지부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 업무를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Duties of the Comprehensive Support Center for the Homeless) ① The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” in Article 19, subparagraph 5 of the Act refers to the duties of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 노숙인 등을 노숙인시설 간에 전원조치할 경우 이에 대한 조정, 협의 및 결정
rows.text_en: 1. Coordination, consultation, and decision regarding the transfer of homeless individuals, etc., between homeless shelters

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제19조제3호에 따른 복지서비스 이력 관리를 위한 시스템 사용
rows.text_en: 2. Use of system for welfare service history management pursuant to Article 19 , Subparagraph 3 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 노숙인 등에 대한 위기관리사업 등 노숙인 등의 복지증진에 필요한 사업으로 보건복지부장관이 정하는 사업
rows.text_en: 3. Other projects necessary for the promotion of welfare of the homeless, etc., such as crisis management projects for the homeless, etc., as determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항제2호에 따른 시스템은 「사회복지사업법」 제6조의2제2항에 따른 정보시스템과 연계할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The system under Article 1, subparagraph 2 may be linked with the information system under Article 6-2, paragraph 2 of the Social Welfare Business Act .

rows.source_ko: 제23조(인권교육) ① 법 제20조제1항에 따른 교육(이하 “인권교육”이라 한다)에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2026. 1. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Human Rights Education) ① Education under Article 20 , Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “human rights education”) shall include the following matters: <Amended Jan. 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 노숙인 등에 대한 인권보호 방안
rows.text_en: 1. Measures for the protection of human rights of the homeless, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 노숙인 등에 대한 인권침해 사례, 구제 및 예방에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning cases of human rights violations against the homeless, etc., as well as remedies and prevention

rows.source_ko: 3. 노숙인시설 종사자의 인권 감수성 향상에 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters necessary to enhance the human rights sensitivity of staff at homeless shelters

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 노숙인 등에 대한 인권침해 예방에 필요하다고 보건복지부장관이 정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare as necessary for the prevention of human rights violations against the homeless, etc.

rows.source_ko: ② 인권교육 시간은 매년 4시간 이상으로 한다. <개정 2026. 1. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The duration of human rights education shall be at least four hours per year. <Amended Jan. 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 노숙인시설의 장은 종사자들이 인권교육에 참여하도록 필요한 지원을 하여야 한다. <개정 2026. 1. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ The head of a homeless shelter shall provide necessary support to ensure that staff members participate in human rights education. <Amended Jan. 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ④ 다음 각 호의 기관은 법 제20조제3항에 따라 인권교육기관으로 지정된 것으로 본다. <신설 2026. 1. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ The institutions listed in each of the following subparagraphs shall be deemed to have been designated as human rights education institutions pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 3 of the Act . <Newly added Jan. 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「국가인권위원회법」에 따른 국가인권위원회
rows.text_en: 1. National Human Rights Commission pursuant to the National Human Rights Commission Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「국민기초생활 보장법」 제15조의2에 따른 한국자활복지개발원
rows.text_en: 2. Korea Institute for Self-Reliance Welfare Development pursuant to Article 15-2 of the National Basic Living Security Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 「한국보건복지인재원법」에 따른 한국보건복지인재원
rows.text_en: 3. Korea Health and Welfare Human Resources Development Institute pursuant to the "Korea Health and Welfare Human Resources Development Institute Act"

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 법 제20조제3항에 따라 인권교육기관으로 지정받으려는 기관ㆍ법인 또는 단체가 갖추어야 하는 요건은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2026. 1. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The requirements that an institution, corporation, or organization seeking designation as a human rights education institution pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 3 of the Act must meet are as follows: <Amended Jan. 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 인권교육 업무를 수행하기에 적합한 인권교육 운영계획을 갖출 것
rows.text_en: 1. Establish a human rights education operational plan suitable for carrying out human rights education duties.

rows.source_ko: 2. 인권교육 업무를 담당하는 사람을 1명 이상 둘 것
rows.text_en: 2. Appoint at least one person responsible for human rights education.

rows.source_ko: 3. 강의실을 1개 이상 소유 또는 임차 등의 방법으로 확보할 것
rows.text_en: 3. Secure at least one classroom by owning or leasing.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 법 제20조제3항에 따라 인권교육기관으로 지정받으려는 자는 별지 제19호서식의 인권교육기관 지정 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 보건복지부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <신설 2026. 1. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ Any person who intends to be designated as a human rights education institution pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall submit an application for designation as a human rights education institution in the form of Annex 19 to the Minister of Health and Welfare, attaching the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Newly added Jan. 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 정관 또는 이에 준하는 규정
rows.text_en: 1. Articles of Incorporation or equivalent regulations

rows.source_ko: 2. 제5항제1호에 따른 인권교육 운영계획
rows.text_en: 2. Human rights education operation plan pursuant to Paragraph 5, Subparagraph 1

rows.source_ko: 3. 제5항제2호에 따른 인력을 갖추었음을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 3. Documents proving that the personnel pursuant to Paragraph 5, Subparagraph 2 have been secured

rows.source_ko: 4. 제5항제3호에 따른 강의실을 갖추었음을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 4. Documents proving that a classroom has been equipped pursuant to Paragraph 5, Subparagraph 3

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 보건복지부장관은 법 제20조제3항에 따라 인권교육기관을 지정한 경우에는 별지 제20호서식의 인권교육기관 지정서를 지정 받은 기관ㆍ법인 또는 단체에 발급해야 한다. <신설 2026. 1. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ In cases where the Minister of Health and Welfare designates a human rights education institution pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 3 of the Act , the Minister shall issue a Certificate of Designation as a Human Rights Education Institution in the form of Annex 20 to the designated institution, corporation, or organization. <Newly added Jan. 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 법 제20조제4항제4호의 “인권교육기관의 운영 실적이 보건복지부령으로 정하는 기준에 미치지 못한 경우”란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우를 말한다. <신설 2026. 1. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ The phrase “cases where the operational performance of a human rights education institution falls short of the standards prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” under Article 20, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 4 of the Act refers to any of the following cases: <Newly added Jan. 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 정당한 사유 없이 6개월 이상 인권교육을 실시하지 않는 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Cases where human rights education is not conducted for more than 6 months without justifiable reason

rows.source_ko: 2. 정당한 사유 없이 제5항제1호에 따른 인권교육 운영계획을 이행하지 않는 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Failure to implement the human rights education operation plan pursuant to Paragraph 5, Subparagraph 1 without justifiable grounds

rows.source_ko: 3. 인권교육 과정을 부실하게 운영하여 그 업무를 적정하게 실시할 수 없다고 인정되는 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Cases where it is deemed that the duties cannot be properly carried out due to the poor operation of the human rights education course

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 법 제20조제4항에 따른 인권교육기관의 지정취소ㆍ업무정지 처분의 기준은 별표 3과 같다. <신설 2026. 1. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ The standards for the revocation of designation and suspension of operations of human rights education institutions pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 4 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 3. <Newly added Jan. 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 법 제20조제4항에 따라 인권교육기관의 지정이 취소된 경우 해당 기관의 장은 인권교육기관 지정서를 지체 없이 보건복지부장관에게 반납해야 한다. <신설 2026. 1. 30.>
rows.text_en: 10. In the event that the designation of a human rights education institution is revoked pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 4 of the Act , the head of the relevant institution shall return the certificate of designation to the Minister of Health and Welfare without delay. <Newly added Jan. 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 제1항부터 제10항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 인권교육의 방법, 교육 경비 등에 필요한 세부적인 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정한다. <신설 2026. 1. 30.>
rows.text_en: 11. In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 through 10, detailed matters necessary for the methods of human rights education, education expenses, etc. shall be determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare . <Newly added Jan. 30, 2026>
[Title amended Jan. 30, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제23조의2(보수교육) ① 법 제20조의2제1항에 따른 보수교육(이하 “보수교육”이라 한다)에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 23-2 (Continuing Education) ① Continuing education pursuant to Article 20-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “continuing education”) shall include the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 노숙인 복지 정책 및 노숙인 복지 실천기술
rows.text_en: 1. Homeless Welfare Policies and Practical Techniques for Homeless Welfare

rows.source_ko: 2. 노숙인 복지 윤리 및 인권보호
rows.text_en: 2. Homeless Welfare Ethics and Human Rights Protection

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 노숙인시설 종사자의 전문성과 자질 향상에 필요하다고 보건복지부장관이 정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Other matters determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare as necessary for improving the professionalism and qualifications of staff at homeless shelters

rows.source_ko: ② 보수교육은 매년 8시간 이상으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Continuing education shall be at least 8 hours per year.

rows.source_ko: ③ 노숙인시설의 장은 노숙인시설 종사자들이 보수교육을 받을 수 있도록 필요한 지원을 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The head of a homeless shelter must provide necessary support so that staff members can receive refresher training.

rows.source_ko: ④ 다음 각 호의 기관은 법 제20조의2제2항에 따라 보수교육기관으로 지정된 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ④ The institutions listed in each of the following subparagraphs shall be deemed to have been designated as continuing education institutions pursuant to Article 20-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: 1. 「국민기초생활 보장법」 제15조의2에 따른 한국자활복지개발원
rows.text_en: 1. Korea Institute for Self-Reliance Welfare Development pursuant to Article 15-2 of the National Basic Living Security Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「한국보건복지인재원법」에 따른 한국보건복지인재원
rows.text_en: 2. Korea Health and Welfare Human Resources Development Institute pursuant to the "Korea Health and Welfare Human Resources Development Institute Act"

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 법 제20조의2제2항에 따라 보수교육기관으로 지정받으려는 기관ㆍ법인 또는 단체가 갖추어야 하는 요건은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The requirements that an institution, corporation, or organization seeking designation as a continuing education institution pursuant to Article 20-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act must meet are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 보수교육 업무를 수행하기에 적합한 보수교육 운영계획을 갖출 것
rows.text_en: 1. Establish a continuing education operational plan suitable for carrying out continuing education duties.

rows.source_ko: 2. 보수교육 업무를 담당하는 사람을 1명 이상 둘 것
rows.text_en: 2. Appoint at least one person responsible for continuing education duties.

rows.source_ko: 3. 강의실을 1개 이상 소유 또는 임차 등의 방법으로 확보할 것
rows.text_en: 3. Secure at least one classroom by owning or leasing.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 법 제20조의2제2항에 따라 보수교육기관으로 지정받으려는 자는 별지 제21호서식의 보수교육기관 지정 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 보건복지부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ Any person who intends to be designated as a continuing education institution pursuant to Article 20-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Health and Welfare an application for designation as a continuing education institution in the form of Annex 21 , attaching the documents of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 정관 또는 이에 준하는 규정
rows.text_en: 1. Articles of Incorporation or equivalent regulations

rows.source_ko: 2. 제5항제1호에 따른 보수교육 운영계획
rows.text_en: 2. Operation plan for continuing education pursuant to Paragraph 5, Subparagraph 1

rows.source_ko: 3. 제5항제2호에 따른 인력을 갖추었음을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 3. Documents proving that the personnel pursuant to Paragraph 5, Subparagraph 2 have been secured

rows.source_ko: 4. 제5항제3호에 따른 강의실을 갖추었음을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 4. Documents proving that a classroom has been equipped pursuant to Paragraph 5, Subparagraph 3

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 보건복지부장관은 법 제20조의2제2항에 따라 보수교육기관을 지정한 경우에는 별지 제22호서식의 보수교육기관 지정서를 지정 받은 기관ㆍ법인 또는 단체에 발급해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ In cases where the Minister of Health and Welfare has designated a continuing education institution pursuant to Article 20-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act , he/she shall issue a certificate of designation of a continuing education institution in the form of Annex 22 to the designated institution, corporation, or organization.

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 법 제20조의2제3항제4호의 “보수교육기관의 운영 실적이 보건복지부령으로 정하는 기준에 미치지 못한 경우”란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우를 말한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ The phrase “cases where the operational performance of a continuing education institution falls short of the standards prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” in Article 20-2, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 4 of the Act refers to any of the following cases:

rows.source_ko: 1. 정당한 사유 없이 6개월 이상 보수교육을 실시하지 않는 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Cases where continuing education is not conducted for more than 6 months without justifiable reason

rows.source_ko: 2. 정당한 사유 없이 제5항제1호에 따른 보수교육 운영계획을 이행하지 않는 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Failure to implement the continuing education operation plan pursuant to Paragraph 5, Subparagraph 1 without justifiable grounds

rows.source_ko: 3. 보수교육 과정을 부실하게 운영하여 그 업무를 적정하게 실시할 수 없다고 인정되는 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Cases where it is deemed that duties cannot be properly performed due to the poor operation of the continuing education course

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 법 제20조의2제3항에 따른 보수교육기관의 지정취소ㆍ업무정지 처분의 기준은 별표 4와 같다.
rows.text_en: ⑨ The standards for the cancellation of designation and suspension of business of continuing education institutions pursuant to Article 20-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act are as set forth in Table 4 .

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 법 제20조의2제3항에 따라 보수교육기관의 지정이 취소된 경우 해당 기관의 장은 보수교육기관 지정서를 지체 없이 보건복지부장관에게 반납해야 한다.
rows.text_en: 10. In the event that the designation of a continuing education institution is revoked pursuant to Article 20-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act , the head of the institution shall return the certificate of designation to the Minister of Health and Welfare without delay.

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 제1항부터 제10항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 보수교육의 방법 및 교육 경비 등에 필요한 세부적인 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: 11. In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 10, detailed matters necessary for the methods of continuing education and education expenses, etc. shall be determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare .

[This Article was newly inserted on Jan. 30, 2026.]
[Formerly Article 23-2 was moved to Article 23-3 <Jan. 30, 2026>]

rows.source_ko: 제23조의3(인권지킴이단의 구성ㆍ운영) ① 인권지킴이단은 단장 1명과 간사 1명을 포함하여 5명 이상 11명 이내의 단원으로 구성한다.
rows.text_en: Article 23-3 (Composition and Operation of the Human Rights Guardian Corps) ① The Human Rights Guardian Corps shall be composed of at least 5 and no more than 11 members, including one leader and one secretary.

rows.source_ko: ② 단원의 임기는 2년으로 하되, 연임할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The term of office for a member shall be two years, and they may serve consecutive terms.

rows.source_ko: ③ 단원은 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람 중에서 관할 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 위촉한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Members shall be appointed by the competent mayor, county governor, or district head from among persons falling under any of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 해당 시설에서 생활하는 노숙인 등의 법정대리인
rows.text_en: 1. Legal representative of homeless people, etc. living in the relevant facility

rows.source_ko: 2. 해당 시설의 종사자(시설 운영자, 시설이 속한 법인의 임직원 등 시설의 운영과 직접 관계된 사람은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Employees of the relevant facility (excluding persons directly related to the operation of the facility, such as facility operators and executives and employees of the corporation to which the facility belongs)

rows.source_ko: 3. 해당 시설의 지역에 거주하는 주민
rows.text_en: 3. Residents living in the area of ​​the facility

rows.source_ko: 4. 해당 시설을 후원하는 기관의 대표자 또는 관련 공익단체에서 추천하는 사람
rows.text_en: 4. The representative of the institution sponsoring the facility or a person recommended by a related public interest organization.

rows.source_ko: 5. 노숙인 등의 복지 업무 담당 공무원
rows.text_en: 5. Public officials in charge of welfare affairs for the homeless, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 노숙인 등의 인권에 관한 학식과 경험이 풍부한 사람
rows.text_en: 6. Other persons with extensive knowledge and experience regarding the human rights of the homeless, etc.

rows.source_ko: ④ 단장은 단원 중에서 호선하고, 간사는 단원 중에서 단장이 지명하는 사람으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The leader shall be elected from among the members, and the secretary shall be a person designated by the leader from among the members.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 단장은 정기적으로 매 분기 1회 이상 회의를 소집하고, 단원, 시설 종사자, 시설에서 생활하는 노숙인 등의 요청이 있는 경우 수시로 회의를 소집할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The director shall convene a meeting at least once every quarter on a regular basis, and may convene a meeting at any time upon request from members, facility staff, homeless people living in the facility, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제1항부터 제5항까지 규정한 사항 외에 인권지킴이단의 구성ㆍ운영에 필요한 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 5, matters necessary for the composition and operation of the Human Rights Guardians shall be determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare .

[This Article was newly added on June 12, 2019.]
[Moved from Article 23-2; former Article 23-3 moved to Article 23-4 <Jan. 30, 2026>]

rows.source_ko: 제23조의4(현장조사서) 법 제21조의4제2항에서 “보건복지부령으로 정하는 사항이 기재된 서류”란 다음 각 호의 사항이 기재된 현장조사서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 23-4 (Field Investigation Report) In Article 21-4, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the phrase “document containing matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” refers to a field investigation report containing the matters of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 조사기간
rows.text_en: 1. Investigation Period

rows.source_ko: 2. 조사범위
rows.text_en: 2. Scope of Investigation

rows.source_ko: 3. 조사담당자
rows.text_en: 3. Investigator

rows.source_ko: 4. 관계법령
rows.text_en: 4. Relevant Laws and Regulations

rows.source_ko: 5. 제출자료
rows.text_en: 5. Submission Materials

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 해당 현장조사와 관련하여 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Other matters necessary in relation to the relevant on-site investigation

[This Article was newly added on June 12, 2019.]
[Moved from Article 23-3 on Jan. 30, 2026.]

rows.source_ko: 제24조(보고) ① 입소시설 및 노숙인종합지원센터의 장은 입소ㆍ퇴소, 서비스 제공 및 연계 등 노숙인 등의 시설 이용 현황에 관한 기록을 항상 유지ㆍ관리하여야 하며, 분기마다 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 작성하여 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2026. 1. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 24 (Reporting) ① The heads of residential facilities and comprehensive support centers for the homeless shall at all times maintain and manage records regarding the status of facility usage by homeless persons, etc., including admission, discharge, provision of services, and referrals, and shall prepare documents (including electronic documents) classified according to each of the following subparagraphs every quarter and submit them to the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head. <Amended Jan. 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 입소시설: 별지 제23호서식의 노숙인자활시설 이용 현황 또는 별지 제24호서식의 노숙인재활시설ㆍ노숙인요양시설 이용 현황
rows.text_en: 1. Admission Facilities: Status of Usage of Homeless Self-Reliance Facilities ( Form No. 23) or Status of Usage of Homeless Rehabilitation Facilities/Homeless Nursing Facilities (Form No. 24)

rows.source_ko: 2. 노숙인종합지원센터: 별지 제25호서식의 노숙인종합지원센터 이용 현황
rows.text_en: 2. Comprehensive Support Center for the Homeless: Usage Status of Comprehensive Support Center for the Homeless (Form No. 25)

rows.source_ko: ② 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제1항에 따라 받은 서류를 모아 시설별로 노숙인 등의 시설 이용 현황을 작성하고, 분기마다 특별시장ㆍ광역시장ㆍ도지사ㆍ특별자치도지사(이하 “시ㆍ도지사”라 한다)에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor, County Governor, or District Head shall collect the documents received pursuant to Paragraph 1, prepare a report on the status of facility usage by homeless persons, etc. for each facility, and submit it to the Mayor of a Special City, Metropolitan City, Governor of a Province, or Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as the “Mayor/Governor of a City/Province”) on a quarterly basis.

rows.source_ko: ③ 시ㆍ도지사는 제2항에 따라 받은 서류를 모아 시설별로 노숙인 등의 시설 이용 현황을 작성하고, 이를 다음 각 호의 구분에 따라 보건복지부장관에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 12. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Mayor or Provincial Governor shall collect the documents received pursuant to Paragraph 2, prepare a report on the status of facility usage by homeless persons, etc. for each facility, and submit it to the Minister of Health and Welfare in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Dec. 30, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 1. 노숙인재활시설 및 노숙인요양시설 이용 현황: 반기별 1회
rows.text_en: 1. Status of Usage of Homeless Rehabilitation and Nursing Facilities: Once every six months
